input.use_case: 作業動画の時間窓アノテーション
input.state: The input is a robot coffee-preparation clip, or a still-image control. The target is the small round light-colored coffee capsule initially near the lower center, not the clear drinking cup on the right. Time is relative to the supplied clip, starting at 0 seconds.
